input.text: Right now your program compares the raw input to its reverse, so it only works when the letters already match exactly. To make the palindrome check ignore case and spaces, think about building a cleaned-up version of the string first: same letters, all lowercase, with spaces removed. Then check whether that cleaned-up string reads the same forward and backward.
